data.description: Discover a seaside escape at Port de La Mer, where luxury meets tranquility.

data.answer:
Port de La Mer is part of the La Mer project by Meraas, which is located in Jumeirah. The community has different sections, offering various property choices for both buyers and renters. With its stone-paved streets, lovely walkways, and green spaces, this beautiful neighborhood perfectly reflects coastal living.

The lifestyle here is both relaxed and elegant, making it ideal for families and  professionals. Its location lets residents enjoy the peaceful seaside while staying close to the city’s busy areas like Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport.

Port de La Mer is a prestigious waterfront community by Meraas, offering an exquisite selection of upscale residential properties. The area primarily features 1- to 4-bedroom apartments, designed with a Mediterranean aesthetic and modern comforts, providing a perfect blend of luxury and coastal living. You can also find townhouses in the area for those looking for more space and privacy.

These apartments are equipped with spacious living areas, elegantly designed kitchens, and large windows that invite ample natural light, enhancing the open and airy atmosphere. Many units come with en-suite master bedrooms, built-in wardrobes, and balconies offering stunning views of the marina or Arabian Gulf.

For those seeking outdoor living, Port de La Mer provides residents with access to private beaches, gardens, and promenades along the waterfront. In addition, some apartments come with access to shared amenities, such as temperature-controlled swimming pools, fitness centers, and children's play areas, ensuring a lifestyle that caters to relaxation and leisure.

Properties for Rent in Port de La Mer

Searching for properties for rent in Dubai? Port de La Mer provides a range of rental options, ideal for individuals and families looking for a premium coastal lifestyle. The available properties for rent include spacious 1-bedroom apartments, with rental prices starting at AED 110,000 per year. 

For those needing more space, 2-bedroom apartments are available starting from AED 150,000 annually. Larger 3-bedroom apartments, perfect for families, begin at AED 230,000 per year, offering a luxurious living experience by the sea.

Properties for Sale in Port de La Mer

For those considering investment opportunities in Dubai real estate, Port de La Mer offers a variety of exceptional properties for sale. Buyers can choose from 1-bedroom apartments starting at AED 1.3 million, 2-bedroom apartments priced at AED 2.1 million, and 3-bedroom apartments beginning at AED 3.5 million.

Additionally, there are luxurious townhouses and villas available, with prices starting from AED 6 million. These properties offer a blend of luxury, comfort, and the prime location that makes Port de La Mer a highly desirable residential destination.

more_info.question: What to Expect When Living in Port de La Mer?

data.answer:
Living in Port de La Mer offers a blend of luxury and relaxation. Residents enjoy easy access to the beach, marina, and a wide array of dining and retail options within the community. The area’s laid-back vibe makes it a perfect spot for families and individuals looking to enjoy a peaceful lifestyle, with plenty of outdoor spaces, parks, and recreational facilities. The community also has a strong sense of privacy, making it a sought-after location for those who value serenity.

Public Transportation in Port de La Mer

There are multiple bus stations in Jumeirah 1 just a short distance from Port De La Mer, providing convenient connections to other parts of Dubai. The closest options include Palm Strip Center Bus Stop and Jumeirah Centre Bus Stop, both about a 5-minute drive away. For metro access, the World Trade Centre Metro Station is reachable in around 15 minutes.

Supermarkets in Port de La Mer

A branch of Géant Express is part of the community. For more options, residents can go to Spinneys, located just a 6-minute drive away.

Shopping Malls in Port de La Mer

Located just 11 minutes away in Jumeirah 1, Mercato Mall offers a unique shopping experience. The mall's name, meaning “market” in Italian, is reflected in its captivating architecture, inspired by Renaissance Europe. It features an array of retail outlets, restaurants, and entertainment options that appeal to families, couples, and individuals alike.

Mercato Mall is not just about shopping—it offers a variety of experiences under one roof. Visitors can enjoy dining at the food court, which offers a range of international cuisines, or catch the latest movies at VOX Cinemas. For families, the little ones can explore Fun City, a dedicated play area. The mall also houses well-known brands such as Charles & Keith, Damas, and Diesel, making it a popular destination for fashion enthusiasts.

Schools in and Near Port de La Mer

For primary education, one highly regarded option is GEMS Wellington Primary School, located a short drive away. Offering the British curriculum, this school caters to students from the Foundation Stage through to Grade 6. GEMS Wellington has multiple branches across Dubai, including in areas such as Downtown, DIFC, and Bur Dubai.

Other nearby schools include Al Shorouq Private School and JSS Private School, all within a 20-minute drive of Port de La Mer. 

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Port de La Mer

If you're looking for a nearby mosque, a short drive to central Jumeirah will bring you to several, including the well-known Jumeirah Mosque. For those attending churches, locations such as Emirates Baptist Church International are about 20 minutes away.

For other places of worship, Mahamevnawa Buddhist Temple is just an 8-minute drive, and Hindu temples in Bur Dubai are reachable in around 18 minutes.

Clinics and Hospitals in and Near Port de La Mer

For medical needs, residents have access to several clinics in the vicinity. Arya Clinic and NMC Healthcare are both within an 8- to 10-minute drive, providing convenient healthcare options. Additionally, the Iranian Hospital is just a 10-minute drive from Port De La Mer, offering more comprehensive medical services.

Port de La Mer Location & Nearby Areas

Port de La Mer is ideally located in Jumeirah, providing convenient access to some of Dubai’s most important areas. Downtown Dubai is just a 15-minute drive away, making it easy for residents to reach the city's main business and leisure districts. 

Dubai International Airport is only 20 minutes by car, ensuring quick connections for frequent travelers. For those who enjoy the beach, Jumeirah Beach is a short 10-minute drive, while La Mer Beach, known for its vibrant atmosphere and beautiful views, is just 5 minutes away, offering residents easy access to seaside relaxation.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Port de La Mer

data.answer:
Port De La Mer is a premium seafront residential development, housing a range of amenities for a luxury lifestyle. However, the lack of public transportation can be a hassle. Residents need to go out of the community boundaries to catch a public bus.

Restaurants in and Near Port de La Mer

You can find a variety of dining options near Port de La Mer. For a taste of Turkish and Lebanese cuisine, visit Zou Zou Restaurant, which is just a 7-minute drive away. If you're in the mood for Turkish steaks, Butcha Turkish Steakhouse & Grill is another excellent choice, offering authentic flavors and located within easy reach.

Beaches Near Port de La Mer

J1 Beach, a newly reimagined destination replacing La Mer Beach, is set to be the latest attraction in the neighborhood. With a variety of retail outlets, food stalls, and a waterpark, this beachfront promises to be a perfect family-friendly getaway, just a short walk away.

Hotels in Port de La Mer

Visitors and residents of Port de La Mer can enjoy luxurious accommodations at several nearby hotels. One such option is the Mandarin Oriental Jumeirah, located just a 10-minute drive from the community.

This hotel offers world-class service and stunning views of the Arabian Gulf. Another excellent choice is the Four Seasons Resort Dubai, situated 12 minutes away. This beachfront resort combines elegance and comfort, providing guests with a premium experience along Dubai’s beautiful coastline. Both hotels offer top-tier amenities, making them perfect for a relaxing and indulgent stay.

Attractions and Landmarks in and Near Port de La Mer

Port de La Mer is conveniently located near some of Dubai's most famous attractions and landmarks. One of the most iconic sites is the Burj Khalifa, the world’s tallest tower, which is just a 15-minute drive away. 

Close to the Burj Khalifa, visitors can also enjoy the Dubai Fountain, a breathtaking water show that is approximately 18 minutes away. For those interested in cultural experiences, the Dubai Opera is another prominent landmark located around 18 minutes from Port de La Mer, offering a variety of performances and events.

Outdoor Activities, Gyms, and Salons

Port de La Mer offers ample opportunities for outdoor activities. Residents can enjoy jogging and cycling along the promenade, and there are numerous gyms and fitness centers nearby, including Fitness First Jumeirah (10 minutes away) and Barry's Bootcamp (12 minutes away). There are also several luxury salons, such as N.Bar Jumeirah (15 minutes away).

While Port de La Mer offers an exceptional lifestyle, it is primarily designed for those seeking a high-end living experience, which may come with a higher price tag. However, the investment potential and luxurious lifestyle make it a worthwhile choice for many.

more_info.question: FAQs About Port de La Mer

data.answer:
What is Port de La Mer by Meraas?

Port de La Mer is a luxury waterfront community by Meraas, located in Jumeirah, Dubai. It offers seaside living with apartments, townhouses, and villas featuring stunning views of the Arabian Gulf.

What types of properties are available in Port de La Mer?

The community offers a range of properties, including 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, penthouses, and townhouses.

Is Port de La Mer family-friendly?

Yes, Port de La Mer is a family-friendly community with parks, playgrounds, beaches, and a relaxed environment perfect for families with children.

What amenities can residents enjoy at Port de La Mer?

Residents have access to private beaches, a marina, retail shops, restaurants, swimming pools, and fitness centers, as well as beautifully landscaped open spaces.

How far is Port de La Mer from Downtown Dubai?

Port de La Mer is approximately a 15-minute drive from Downtown Dubai, offering easy access to the city’s major landmarks and business districts.

Is public transportation available near Port de La Mer?

While the community is primarily car-friendly, there are nearby bus routes and metro stations within a short driving distance for those relying on public transport.

Are there any schools or nurseries near Port de La Mer?

Yes, several reputable schools and nurseries are located nearby, including Jumeirah English Speaking School and GEMS Wellington International School.

Can non-UAE residents buy property in Port de La Mer?

Yes, Port de La Mer is a freehold community, meaning foreign investors and non-UAE residents can purchase property here.

What are the main attractions near Port de La Mer?

Some of the main attractions near Port de La Mer include La Mer Beach, Kite Beach, Dubai Mall, and Burj Khalifa, all within a 20-minute drive.

data.content:
Port de La Mer by Meraas is an exclusive seaside community located in the vibrant Jumeirah area of Dubai. This luxurious waterfront development offers residents stunning views of the Arabian Gulf, surrounded by sandy beaches and a serene marina. Moreover, it is home to a +190 berth marina and yacht club.

Port de La Mer is home to a wide range of properties, including apartments, townhouses, and villas, all designed with elegant Mediterranean-style architecture. This community is ideal for those looking to experience the finest aspects of Dubai’s coastal lifestyle while still being close to the city’s main attractions.

This development offers exclusive residential properties for sale, including a selection of apartments, penthouses, and townhouses. The master plan boasts premium restaurants, various leisure activities, and luxury resorts, providing residents with a well-rounded living experience. The low-rise buildings further enhance the appeal, offering breathtaking views of Pearl Jumeirah, making this a prime choice for those seeking a sophisticated lifestyle.

nodes.title: Solaya
nodes.about:
Solaya at La Mer is a prestigious beachfront development by Meraas, offering a private collection of 234 residences across nine architecturally distinctive buildings. Situated along a 500-metre-long stretch of pristine beachfront, the project features 2, 3, 4, and 5-bedroom apartments, 3-bedroom garden residences, 4-bedroom duplexes, and 5-bedroom penthouses. Each home is designed to maximize natural light and uninterrupted views of the sea and city.

Meraas Solaya Dubai redefines luxury living by integrating contemporary architecture, curated landscapes, and world-class amenities such as the sunset pool, gardens, beach retreats, and yoga decks. With its prime location in La Mer, Jumeirah, residents are minutes away from Dubai’s most iconic destinations, ensuring both exclusivity and convenience. This landmark project combines lifestyle appeal with strong ROI potential, making it a standout investment in the emirate.
